fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/doclinks/... passes (no broken relative link in the real README.md and docs/) and make self-check passes (rhiza check's docs-commands rule finds no rhiza command in README.md or docs/ that does not exist), grep finds neither {"writes" nor "quotes" in docs/concepts/why.md, and the owner approves the page at the run's sign-off
fields.statement: docs/concepts/why.md reads in the owner's voice and writes the decision and its link with plain rhiza add and rhiza link commands instead of an apply JSON file; the Source example shows no hand-written JSON either: it has the agent scrub the conversation with the rhiza scrub skill, which writes the file and runs rhiza source add, and the page names rhiza source add and its --raw, --raw-sha256 and --raw-session flags in prose
